name: HTN04a: Known HTN cases on Treatment
description:
Number of known Hypertension cases active on ART who were receiving documented Hypertension treatment during the reporting quarter.
The patient must be a known hypertensive case and have a status indicating lifestyle modification, medication plus lifestyle modification, or both. Patients explicitly documented as not on treatment are excluded.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.htn_status IN (
      'Known Hypertensive, not controlled and on lifestyle modification and Medication',
      'Known Hypertensive, not controlled and on lifestyle modification',
      'Known Hypertensive and Controlled and on lifestyle modification',
      'Known Hypertensive and Controlled and on lifestyle modification and Medication'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
